quant.name: W4A8_DYNAMIC
notes: Grouped output A and B use BF16 operands in the retained TransposeBatchMatMul and MatMulV3 tensor ABI; no observed duration is a parameter.
The base preset remains on Q/K and shared/expert projections; the catalog INT8 indexer representation is retained.

metadata.mtp: MTP1 deepseek_mtp, the checkpoint's own one-layer DeepSeekV4MTPModel drafter, num_speculative_tokens=1; measured mean acceptance length 2.00 in every cell. Declared as the measured acceptance with a zero additive step cost because the served step interval already contains draft+verify. The catalog auxiliary dspark draft is a 3-layer foreign spec and is not lowered. 100% draft acceptance is a workload artefact (uniform-random greedy prompts collapse to degenerate continuations), not a model property.
metadata.mtp_acceptance_source: .workstreams/hp-serving/v4pro-a3-w4a8/report.md section 5: Mean acceptance length 2.00 in every cell; Prometheus accepted/drafted 10,234/10,245 (99.89%) at p4096/c1, 10,190/10,289 (99.04%) at p16384/c1, 10,231/10,240 (99.91%) at p61440/c1.
metadata.graph: cudagraph_mode=FULL_DECODE_ONLY + npugraph_ex; six decode capture sizes, capture about 39 s / 0.64 GiB. The report publishes the count but not the six values; this case declares six buckets [1, 2, 4, 8, 12, 16], all within max_num_seqs 16, so the c1 and c4 capture classes are represented. The bucket values are a declared modeling input, not a claimed measurement.
metadata.chunked_prefill: enabled, max_num_batched_tokens=1024; a 61,440-token prompt is 60 scheduler chunks and about 28.9 s of prefill
metadata.kv_cache: measured engine lines: Available KV cache memory 2.39 GiB -> NPU KV cache size 71,891 tokens; after warmup Current KV cache memory 2.41 GiB; Maximum concurrency for 65,536 tokens per request 1.10x; about 35.1 KiB/token/die. The analytic compressed-row model prices 9,310.5 B/token (1,257,600 tokens). These are different quantities (static engine pool vs compressed live rows): the measured 71,891-token pool is declared as the admission capacity (kv_pool_tokens / kv_pool_measured_tokens) and the analytic number stays the live-row price, reported separately and never used as an admission fallback. The pool is why 131072 is refused and why c4 at p61440 serialized.
metadata.kv_pool_admission: runtime.metadata.kv_pool_tokens=71891 + kv_pool_measured_tokens=71891 (the engine's own NPU KV cache size line) overrides the analytic admission capacity. A request is admitted only when its whole prompt allocation (ceil(prompt/128) blocks) fits the measured pool; otherwise it is deferred with kv_capacity_blocked_admission and re-admitted when an earlier request releases its blocks. A finished request holds its prompt reservation until its declared output completes, because the engine cannot free context rows it still needs. This reproduces the measured p61440/c4 serialization (one 65,536-token context at a time) while leaving the four p16384/c4 and p4096/c4 requests concurrent (prompt allocations 4x128=512 and 4x32=128 blocks both fit 561 blocks).
metadata.kv_pool_source: .workstreams/hp-serving/v4pro-a3-w4a8/report.md section 1 (A4 engine line NPU KV cache size: 71,891 tokens) and section 5 (2.41 GiB / 71,891 tokens / about 35.1 KiB/token)
metadata.reduced_config_reason: 128k refused by the engine's own KV check: 4.18 GiB needed vs 2.05-2.39 GiB available; the node can supply at most 3.61 GiB at any gmu (61.28 free - 53.66 weights - 4.01 activation/non-torch/graph). 64k serves with 71,891 tokens. p61440 is the declared 64k rung because prompt + o4096 = 65,536 = max_model_len; it is never quoted as a 65,536-token prompt.
metadata.unsupported_context: 131072 (and any prompt+output above 65,536) is unsupported on this single-node TP16/64 GiB configuration; it is refused, never extrapolated. The p126976 rung needs about 4.05 GiB of KV against a 3.61 GiB ceiling and was not attempted.
metadata.serialization_61k: 4 concurrent requests x 65,536 tokens = 262,144 KV tokens against a 71,891-token pool (364.7% demand, static concurrency 1.10x). The engine ran one 65,536-token context at a time (running max 1, waiting max 3): TTFTs in admission order are 28.8/175.8/322.8/469.3 s, i.e. each next request is admitted only after the previous whole E2E (about 147 s), so TTFT_k = sum(E2E_1..k-1) + prefill_k. This is serialization, not 1/2/3/4 prefills.
metadata.row_policy: measured rows are declared by the cells manifest and applied only when their exact hardware/geometry matches; a foreign-hardware or foreign-shape row is declared missing, never substituted. The measured serving matrix lives only in examples/artifacts/a3-v4pro-tp16-w4a8-mtp-matrix.json and is read only by the comparison runner.
metadata.expert_parallel: the served recipe passes --enable-expert-parallel with TP16 -> EP16 on 16 ranks; 384 routed experts / EP16 = 24 local experts per rank at full moe_intermediate width 3072. The trace has no published EP dispatch/combine row; no all-to-all latency is claimed.
metadata.fabric: 8 SIO intra-package die pairs (448 GB/s, direct) + one 16-die HCCS_SW switched intra-node fabric (196 GB/s declared default). TP16 all-reduce spans eight packages; the A3 comm campaign measured only 2-rank SIO/HCCS_SW and 4-rank package-to-package rows, so the 16-rank all-reduce and the EP16 all-to-all stay analytic and are declared missing.
